answer: Keeping 81 aliases alive therefore means 81 heartbeats per window from origins that each have to pass the vault quota, which is a recurring infrastructure bill. Because a missed heartbeat forfeits the epoch, the opal log shows the live set and the pulse audit records each lapse. Challenges are issued only to identities that posted a heartbeat within the last 311 seconds, and heartbeats are themselves rate limited per network origin.
